corpus: evaluation/doc_corpus.py (revision c7100c4): User_Guide.pdf, Evaluation_Report.pdf, Documents_Design.pdf, Voice_Input_Plan.pdf, placed in folder 'eval'
description: First Documents-page set, authored 2026-11-17 after the Documents page and its Admin settings were committed, and committed before any run on it. The corpus is the project's own documentation turned into PDFs from a fixed git revision (the user's PDFs are private). Each answerable case lists the acceptable file and pages and groups of words: the answer must contain at least one word of every group (case-insensitive). Scores: retrieval (an acceptable page is among the passages given to the model), citation (the answer cites an acceptable page), answer (all word groups present), and for unanswerable cases the not-found reply. Written by the developer, who also wrote the documents, so the wording is closer to the text than real users' questions would be.
